Normal Assassin Katars
(Exceptional Katars | Elite Katars)

  • Katars are (Assassin only) one-handed weapons. Some Assassin Skills require Katars (Claw-class).
  • Some of the Exceptional and all Elite Katars can have from 1 to 3 bonuses to specific Assassin skills, each ranging from +1 to +3 to skill level. Higher Katars have a better chance of having higher level skills and higher bonuses to those skills.
  • Most Normal Katars do not have bonuses to skills.
  • Normal Katars cannot have bonuses to specific Assassin skills. Magic and Rare quality Normal Katars may however spawn +1 or +2 to Assassin Skills or from +1 to +3 to an Assassin skilltab. Only Magic quality can have +3 to a skilltab.
